reviews.x: First of all for $10 I wasn’t expecting much but this bundle came with the most containers which is why I chose it. I’m so surprised at how nice it all is. The silicone is great and easy to get product out of. 6 tubes in 3 different sizes and the labeling can be annoying but common, it’s $10 for 13 items. All you have to do is take the second part of the cap off before you fill it and set it to the correct label. I love how the silicone comes all the way through the cap for leak protection and t

Loved the concept and the silicone of the bottles. Will use for first time this week. Didn’t like that the convenient label on the cap is hard to work with. If I want to reset it from cond to lotion is hard and in one bottle, impossible. This is what attracted me to this on the first place.

These bottles do not leak and they are easy to use. I bought the set with two colors that came with three sizes. I use the purple ones for hair products (shampoo, conditioner, anti-frizz) and the white ones for skin (lotion, sunscreen, face cream) and it's easy to know what I'm grabbing even without looking at the descriptions that can be tailored to the contents. Got these for a week long trip. Unfortunately the bag zipper broke very quickly.  Bottles hold sufficient amounts. They are lightweight as well.

Used for the first time on a recent vacation. I like the different sizes of bottles and you can't beat the price. This is the first time I've used silicone bottles and really like them. We didn't have any issues with any of the bottles leaking, one of the jars did leak on the way home but I really don't know how. There was just a little bit of lotion in it and it may have been my error not sealing it well enough. It was a great purchase and look forward to using them for future travel.
Perfect for traveling! Unlike one of the other reviews I had no issues changing the label. So much comes in this it's such a good deal!

I really wanted to like these travel bottles, but they’re absolutely terrible to use. The lids are definitely not secure because you can’t twist them on. You just pop them over the silicone bottle.  They’re also difficult to clean out so you can reuse them, which is the whole point.  It’s also hard to use all of the product in the bottle because when you squeeze the silicone bottle, the product will just come out the side of the lid instead of the top.  I definitely regret this purchase and wish

Seals have been working at 100%. Easy to open. Sauve to the touch. Easy to clean. Not personally a huge fan of the toothbrush covers but that's a small and easy switch. Labels are sort of awkward when assigning but print seems to be lasting very well. Plenty of room for other small items like lipglosses, vape pens, eye drops, mouth wash bottle, small paint tubes etc. Havent had a single issue with Airport security on the sizes. All A OK!

I took this set to Disney world and it was perfect. It is easy to clean and wonderful size options. I have a couple of complaints. The shampoo, soap,ect labels rub off pretty easily. The shampoo label was gone after one use and some of the others were scratched. My really running shampoo leaked some. My other items didn't leak. I'm sure it is because of the water like consistency of my shampoo, but it is worth nothing.

Love the labels. Wish there was a blank one that I could write in for my shower gel, or hair gel or any other product I may need. Other than that, no leaks, perfect for carry-ons. Easy to get the product out when the bottle runs low because of the flexibility of the silicone. Love the jars for ointments and creams. Highly recommend.

These bottles worked so well I bought 2.  I filled them with everything from shampoo and lotion to hydrogen peroxide and never had a problem with leaking.  It was easy to fill them, but the best part is when I got home it was really easy to clean them out.  I definitely recommend these.

These are great. The silicone is nice and soft and the shape of the bottles makes it easy to get the last bit of soap out. I like having a 1qt bag with an actual zipper, stays closed much better than a ziploc. The cream jars are useful as well.

I absolutely love this set. The bottles are perfect and leak proof. Easy to pack and not made of hard plastic. Soft and bendable. I ended up ordering another set just to have more on hand. Thank you so much for a wonderful purchase😊

I ran into a couple issues with this product, first some of the "labels" wouldnt change effectively so I had to wrestle with them, then after a couple uses of when squeezing the tube it would collapse on itself. Its an okay product.

This product is okay, and I like that it has labels for specific products. However, when there is not much product in there, it's challenging to get out like it doesn't have enough squeezing power to get it out.
It's super easy to put the product in the containers and we have not had any problem with leaking.  They have been on three trips with us now and we have had any leaking or clogging issues.

reviews.t: Looks good but not great quality
reviews.x: The zipper on the bag broke the second trip I made The cap on two of the bottles separated from the bottle and leaked on all my clothes Very poor quality
The containers are great, hold enough, don't leak.  The zipper on the carrying case is junk and broke after opening and closing just a couple times.
These are really great!! They have labels and all and will come in handy on my vacation. Silicone, but very durable and leak proof.
No leakage but hard to get thick lotion out. I use diabetic lotion which is very thick. It’s also hard to wash to get residue out.
I'm glad I bought this set. Will def be my travel go to! No leaks, labels came in handy, affordable. This was a good investment.
Perfect bottles for traveling, whether it is a short weekend trip or a longer one. My granddaughter loves them even for school.
Using them for the first time on our trip to Belize. So far so good. No leaking and I love that you can label them.
We bought two sets for a recent trip and we LOVE these.  They are perfect sizes, leak proof and just worked so well

claims.text: Many reviewers find the set a great value, praising the amount of containers included for the low price.
The silicone bottles are widely liked for being soft, easy to use, and easy to clean, with most reviewers reporting no leaks.
The labels are a common complaint, with several reviewers finding them hard to change or quick to rub off.
A few reviewers report leaking, either from a jar or from a bottle, despite others reporting no leaks.
Some reviewers report durability or usability problems, such as a broken bag zipper, insecure lids, or tubes collapsing.
